prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a chimera on four legs seen from the side: a tawny lion body with a golden mane and exactly three different heads, the same three in every cell and each clearly apart: one grey goat head with curled horns high on the back, one green scaly dragon head on a neck in the middle above the shoulders, and one maned lion head low in front (only one lion head); exactly two leathery bat wings half raised, a live green snake for a tail curled up behind the hips with its head raised; the whole creature, tail to snout, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides; exactly one chimera in each of the three cells, filling its box (one row, three figures in all). Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the lion face with amber eyes is readable, and the goat and dragon heads are clearly visible.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward low, the same three heads as in the idle cell (goat high, dragon in the middle, lion low) snapping toward the heroes with the jaws open, the heads above and just in front of its front feet, all four feet on the ground, the whole chimera well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, all four feet on the ground, the same three heads as in the idle cell (goat high, dragon in the middle, lion low) recoiling, the wings flared, the snake tail coiled, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body but keep all four feet on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): reach the heads toward the heroes with the necks bent so every head stays well inside its own cell; the wings and the snake tail move with the motion, kept close to the body. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a fourth head, two lion heads, a scorpion tail, feathered wings, a human face, fire breath, rearing up, a second row.
